Major AI Developments.title: How AI and smart grids will power Rajasthan’s next renewable energy phase
Major AI Developments.summary: Industry leaders at the ET Government Rajasthan Energy Conclave 2026 emphasized the importance of digital technologies, storage, and predictive analytics in managing Rajasthan's expanding renewable energy sector. AI and smart grids are expected to play a key role in this next phase of renewable energy development. Rajasthan's energy ecosystem will rely on these technologies to optimize its growing renewable energy capacity.

Major AI Developments.title: Silicon Road Ventures partners Ajay Mahajan to float Rs 150 Cr AI fund
Major AI Developments.summary: Silicon Road Ventures has partnered with Ajay Mahajan to launch a Rs 150 crore alternative investment fund focused on early-stage startups building agentic AI solutions in B2B commerce technology. The fund will target areas such as multi-channel commerce, supply chain, and fintech, and has received Category-II registration from Sebi. The investment fund aims to support startups developing innovative AI solutions for the B2B commerce sector.

Major AI Developments.title: Jaipur students launch AI platform for defence families​
Major AI Developments.summary: Students from Jaipur have launched an AI platform designed to support families of defence personnel. The platform aims to provide various services and assistance to these families, leveraging artificial intelligence technology. The launch is a notable initiative by the students to contribute to the welfare of defence families.

Major AI Developments.title: Lumikai leads $1.5 Mn seed round in NPrep
Major AI Developments.summary: NPrep, an AI-powered skilling platform for nursing students and professionals, has raised $1.5 million in a seed funding round led by Lumikai. The round also saw participation from existing investor All In Capital and other investors, including Velo Partners and angel investors. This funding follows a previous pre-seed round led by All In Capital, with the amount undisclosed.

Major AI Developments.title: Rajasthan deploys AI face recognition for exams, law enforcement, and identification
Major AI Developments.summary: Rajasthan's IT department has implemented AI-powered face recognition technology for various applications, including exam candidate verification and law enforcement. The face similarity search system is deployed at a state data centre, enabling matches against large databases of individuals. This technology will aid in identifying offenders, missing persons, and exam candidates, enhancing security and efficiency in these areas.

Major AI Developments.title: Rajasthan rolls out AI-enabled ‘My Career Advisor’ app for students
Major AI Developments.summary: Rajasthan has launched the 'My Career Advisor' app, an AI-enabled mobile platform providing personalized career guidance to students in Classes 9-12. The app aligns student choices with the National Education Policy 2020 through assessments based on aptitude, interest, and skills. The platform aims to offer tailored guidance to students, helping them make informed career decisions.
